_comment: Stage 3 - strained, half-whispered, openly wrong. Voice: hesitant, breathy, cracking.

entries.text: {player}. {player}. I keep saying your name so I don't forget it. So you don't forget it.
Did you hear that? No. Of course you didn't. You never do.
Some of the people you've seen today weren't real. I won't tell you which.
I'm still your friend. I'm STILL your friend. Say it back.
It's getting dark in here. Not out there. In here.
Stop turning around. I'm always going to be behind you now.
We've talked {encounters} times. Every one of them is still happening, somewhere.
